title: Wilderness · Agatha appears

sourceRecords.title: Optional lead · Conyberry and Agatha
read: Beyond the ruined village, branches bend together into a low shelter. The air stills. A voice from within sounds older than the trees: “You came this far to ask me something?”

The low shelter makes a close approach very different from calling out at a distance. Still branches frame the entrance, and the voice waits for an answer. You can offer your purpose plainly, choose your words with care, or keep to the edge of the clearing while you speak.

brief: Inside SAME woven-branch dome with old elven table, shelves, chests, reclining couch. ONE female elf banshee Agatha manifests in pale cold light, spectral long hair and robes, disdainful expression. Upright conversational presence, not screaming attack, skull monster or human murder scene. No magical answer shown in text.
